+/-- Totalizing the simultaneous tensor map agrees with the curried tensor map.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined).
+Proof: remove the identity maps in the two bifunctor components and apply the
+composition law of the totalization functor. -/
+theorem uncurry_map
+    [∀ (V W : CochainComplex A ℤ),
+      HomologicalComplex.HasMapBifunctor V W (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ)]
+    {P Q L K : CochainComplex A ℤ} (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (j : ℤ) :
+    ((Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor A).map₂CochainComplex).map
+      (X := (P, Q)) (Y := (L, K)) (f, g)).f j =
+      (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ)).f j := by
+  let D := (curriedTensor A).mapBifunctorHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ)
+  have h : (Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor A).map₂CochainComplex).map
+      (X := (P, Q)) (Y := (L, K)) (f, g) =
+      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ) := by
+    change HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
+        ((D.map f).app Q ≫ (D.obj L).map (𝟙 Q)) (.up ℤ) ≫
+      HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
+        ((D.map (𝟙 L)).app Q ≫ (D.obj L).map g) (.up ℤ) =
+      HomologicalComplex₂.total.map ((D.map f).app Q ≫ (D.obj L).map g) (.up ℤ)
+    rw [(D.obj L).map_id, D.map_id, NatTrans.id_app, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
+    exact (HomologicalComplex₂.total.map_comp _ _ _).symm
+  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z.f j) h
+
+/-- Countable coproducts supply the total tensor of complexes in a monoidal category.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+theorem tensorTotalHasMap [HasCountableCoproducts A] (P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
+    HomologicalComplex.HasMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ) := by
+  infer_instance

+attribute [local instance 2000] tensorTotalHasMap

+variable (A) [HasCountableCoproducts A] (P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ)

+/-- A degree of the direct-sum total tensor, with its category explicit.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+noncomputable def tensorTotalObj (j : ℤ) : A :=
+  ∐ (fun x : { z : ℤ × ℤ // z.1 + z.2 = j } ↦ P.X x.val.1 ⊗ Q.X x.val.2)
+
+/-- The specified signed total differential between the named degree objects.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+noncomputable def tensorTotalD (i j : ℤ) :
+    tensorTotalObj A P Q i ⟶ tensorTotalObj A P Q j :=
+  (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _)).d i j
+
+/-- The same direct-sum total tensor, with explicit object and differential fields.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+noncomputable def tensorTotal : CochainComplex A ℤ where
+  X := tensorTotalObj A P Q
+  d := tensorTotalD A P Q
+  shape := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _)).shape
+  d_comp_d' := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _)).d_comp_d'
+

+/-- A coproduct injection into the named total degree.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+noncomputable def tensorTotalι (p k j : ℤ) (h : p + k = j) :
+    P.X p ⊗ Q.X k ⟶ tensorTotalObj A P Q j :=
+  Sigma.ι (fun x : { z : ℤ × ℤ // z.1 + z.2 = j } ↦ P.X x.val.1 ⊗ Q.X x.val.2)
+    ⟨(p, k), h⟩
+
+private theorem tensorTotalι_eq (p k j : ℤ) (h : p + k = j) :
+    tensorTotalι A P Q p k j h =
+      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor A) p k j h := by
+  rfl
+
+variable {P Q} {L K : CochainComplex A ℤ}
+
+/-- The original total tensor map, with its degree objects explicit.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined). -/
+noncomputable def tensorTotalMapObj (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (j : ℤ) :
+    tensorTotalObj A P Q j ⟶ tensorTotalObj A L K j :=
+  CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.map
+    (f := fun x : { z : ℤ × ℤ // z.1 + z.2 = j } ↦ P.X x.val.1 ⊗ Q.X x.val.2)
+    (g := fun x : { z : ℤ × ℤ // z.1 + z.2 = j } ↦ L.X x.val.1 ⊗ K.X x.val.2)
+    (fun x ↦ f.f x.val.1 ⊗ₘ g.f x.val.2)
+
+/-- The explicit coproduct map is the standard simultaneous total tensor map.
+Source: Stacks Tag 012Z (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined).
+Proof: compare the composites with every total-degree coproduct injection; the
+standard bifunctor map has exactly these component tensor maps. -/
+theorem tensorTotalMapObj_eq (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (j : ℤ) :
+    tensorTotalMapObj A f g j =
+      (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ)).f j := by
+  apply Sigma.hom_ext
+  rintro ⟨⟨p, k⟩, hpk⟩
+  unfold tensorTotalMapObj
+  rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι_map]
+  change (f.f p ⊗ₘ g.f k) ≫ tensorTotalι A L K p k j hpk =
+    tensorTotalι A P Q p k j hpk ≫
+      (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ)).f j
+  rw [tensorTotalι_eq, tensorTotalι_eq]
+  simpa only [curriedTensor, tensorHom_def, Category.assoc] using
+    (HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor A) (.up ℤ) p k j hpk).symm
+
+omit [(curriedTensor A).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
+  [∀ M : A, ((curriedTensor A).obj M).PreservesZeroMorphisms] in
+private theorem tensorTotalι_map (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K)
+    (p k j : ℤ) (h : p + k = j) :
+    tensorTotalι A P Q p k j h ≫ tensorTotalMapObj A f g j =
+      (f.f p ⊗ₘ g.f k) ≫ tensorTotalι A L K p k j h := by
+  unfold tensorTotalι tensorTotalMapObj
+  exact Sigma.ι_map _ _
+
+end TotalInterface

+variable
+  (U : B ⥤ A) [U.Additive]
+  [HasCountableCoproducts A] [HasCountableCoproducts B]
+  {P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ} {P' Q' : CochainComplex B ℤ}

+omit [U.Additive] in
+private noncomputable def mapX (j : ℤ) :
+    tensorTotalObj A P Q j ⟶ U.obj (tensorTotalObj B P' Q' j) :=

+    U.map (tensorTotalι B P' Q' x.val.1 x.val.2 j x.property))

+omit [U.Additive] in
+private theorem ι_mapX (p k j : ℤ) (h : p + k = j) :
+    CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor A) p k j h ≫ mapX U φ j =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P' Q' (curriedTensor B) p k j h) := by
+  rw [← tensorTotalι_eq, ← tensorTotalι_eq]
+  unfold tensorTotalι mapX
+  exact Sigma.ι_desc _ _

+attribute [local irreducible] mapX

+private theorem mapX_comm
+    (hleft : ∀ p p' k : ℤ, (P.d p p' ▷ Q.X k) ≫ φ p' k =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.d p p' ▷ Q'.X k))
+    (hright : ∀ p k k' : ℤ, (P.X p ◁ Q.d k k') ≫ φ p k' =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.X p ◁ Q'.d k k'))
+    (i j : ℤ) (hij : (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel i j) :
+    (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor A)).d i j ≫ mapX U φ j =
+      mapX U φ i ≫ U.map
+        ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P' Q' (curriedTensor B)).d i j) := by
+  have hj : i + 1 = j := hij
+  subst j
+  apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext
+  intro p k h
+  dsimp only [ComplexShape.π] at h
+  change p + k = i at h
+  subst i
+  let T := curriedTensor A
+  let T' := curriedTensor B
+  have h₁ : p + 1 + k = p + k + 1 := by omega
+  have h₂ : p + (k + 1) = p + k + 1 := by omega
+  simp only [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d_eq, Functor.map_add,
+    Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp, ← Category.assoc]
+  erw [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₂,
+    ι_mapX U φ p k (p + k) rfl]
+  erw [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁_eq P Q T (.up ℤ) rfl k _ h₁,
+    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂_eq P Q T (.up ℤ) p rfl _ h₂]
+  simp only [Category.assoc]
+  erw [← U.map_comp, ← U.map_comp]
+  erw [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₂,
+    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁_eq P' Q' T' (.up ℤ) rfl k _ h₁,
+    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂_eq P' Q' T' (.up ℤ) p rfl _ h₂]
+  simp only [Functor.map_units_smul, Linear.units_smul_comp, Linear.comp_units_smul,
+    Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
+  erw [ι_mapX U φ (p + 1) k (p + k + 1) h₁,
+    ι_mapX U φ p (k + 1) (p + k + 1) h₂]

+  · congr 1
+    have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ U.map
+      (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P' Q' (curriedTensor B)
+        (p + 1) k (p + k + 1) h₁)) (hleft p (p + 1) k)
+    simpa only [T, T', curriedTensor, Category.assoc] using h
+  · congr 1
+    have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ U.map
+      (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P' Q' (curriedTensor B)
+        p (k + 1) (p + k + 1) h₂)) (hright p k (k + 1))
+    simpa only [T, T', curriedTensor, Category.assoc] using h
+

+omit [U.Additive] in
+private theorem mapX_naturality
+    {L K : CochainComplex A ℤ} {L' K' : CochainComplex B ℤ}
+    (ψ : ∀ p k : ℤ, L.X p ⊗ K.X k ⟶ U.obj (L'.X p ⊗ K'.X k))

+      φ p k ≫ U.map (f'.f p ⊗ₘ g'.f k)) (j : ℤ) :
+    tensorTotalMapObj A f g j ≫ mapX U ψ j =
+      mapX U φ j ≫ U.map (tensorTotalMapObj B f' g' j) := by
+  apply Sigma.hom_ext
+  rintro ⟨⟨p, k⟩, hpk⟩
+  change tensorTotalι A P Q p k j hpk ≫
+      tensorTotalMapObj A f g j ≫ mapX U ψ j =
+    tensorTotalι A P Q p k j hpk ≫ mapX U φ j ≫
+      U.map (tensorTotalMapObj B f' g' j)
+  erw [← Category.assoc, tensorTotalι_map A f g p k j hpk]
+  simp only [Category.assoc]
+  erw [ι_mapX U ψ p k j hpk]
+  simp only [← Category.assoc]
+  erw [ι_mapX U φ p k j hpk]
+  simp only [Category.assoc]
+  erw [← U.map_comp, tensorTotalι_map B f' g' p k j hpk, U.map_comp]
+  simpa only [Category.assoc, tensorTotalι_eq] using congrArg
+    (fun z ↦ z ≫ U.map (tensorTotalι B L' K' p k j hpk)) (hφ p k)
+

+private noncomputable def mapComplex
+    (hleft : ∀ p p' k : ℤ, (P.d p p' ▷ Q.X k) ≫ φ p' k =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.d p p' ▷ Q'.X k))

+    (Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor A).map₂CochainComplex).obj (P, Q) ⟶
+      (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
+        ((Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor B).map₂CochainComplex).obj (P', Q')) where

+  comm' := fun i j h ↦ (mapX_comm U φ hleft hright i j h).symm
+
+private theorem mapComplex_f
+    (hleft : ∀ p p' k : ℤ, (P.d p p' ▷ Q.X k) ≫ φ p' k =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.d p p' ▷ Q'.X k))
+    (hright : ∀ p k k' : ℤ, (P.X p ◁ Q.d k k') ≫ φ p k' =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.X p ◁ Q'.d k k')) (j : ℤ) :

+  with_unfolding_all rfl

+attribute [local irreducible] mapComplex

+private theorem mapComplex_naturality
+    (hleft : ∀ p p' k : ℤ, (P.d p p' ▷ Q.X k) ≫ φ p' k =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.d p p' ▷ Q'.X k))
+    (hright : ∀ p k k' : ℤ, (P.X p ◁ Q.d k k') ≫ φ p k' =
+      φ p k ≫ U.map (P'.X p ◁ Q'.d k k'))
+    {L K : CochainComplex A ℤ} {L' K' : CochainComplex B ℤ}
+    (ψ : ∀ p k : ℤ, L.X p ⊗ K.X k ⟶ U.obj (L'.X p ⊗ K'.X k))
+    (hleft' : ∀ p p' k : ℤ, (L.d p p' ▷ K.X k) ≫ ψ p' k =
+      ψ p k ≫ U.map (L'.d p p' ▷ K'.X k))
+    (hright' : ∀ p k k' : ℤ, (L.X p ◁ K.d k k') ≫ ψ p k' =

+    (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (f' : P' ⟶ L') (g' : Q' ⟶ K')

+    rawTensorMap q a b ≫
+      (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars
+        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map q).hom).map
+          (SheafOfModules.CochainScalarConstruction.pureMap S M' N')
+  let β (U : Cᵒᵖ) : M.val.obj U →ₗ[R.obj.obj U]
+      N.val.obj U →ₗ[R.obj.obj U] ((res q).obj (M' ⊗ N')).val.obj U :=
+    TensorProduct.curry (v.app U).hom
+  have hβ {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) (x : M.val.obj U) (y : N.val.obj U) :
+      β V (M.val.map i x) (N.val.map i y) =
+        ((res q).obj (M' ⊗ N')).val.map i (β U x y) := by
+    exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply v i (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj U] y)
+  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := SheafOfModules.CochainScalarConstruction.tensor_bilinear_exists
+    R M N ((res q).obj (M' ⊗ N')) β hβ
+  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
+  intro U x y
+  have hh : φ.val.app U (tensorSection R M N U x y) = β U x y := by
+    unfold tensorSection
+    exact hφ U x y
+  rw [hh]
+  change (SheafOfModules.CochainScalarConstruction.pureMap S M' N').app U
+    ((rawTensorMap q a b).app U (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj U] y)) = _
+  rw [rawTensorMap_tmul]
+  unfold tensorSection SheafOfModules.CochainScalarConstruction.pureMap
+  rfl
+
+private noncomputable def tensorMap : M ⊗ N ⟶ (res q).obj (M' ⊗ N') :=
+  Classical.choose (tensorMap_exists q a b)
+
+attribute [local irreducible] tensorMap
+
+private theorem tensorMap_section (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) (y : N.val.obj U) :
+    (tensorMap q a b).val.app U (tensorSection R M N U x y) =
+      tensorSection S M' N' U (show M'.val.obj U from a.val.app U x)
+        (show N'.val.obj U from b.val.app U y) := by
+  unfold tensorMap
+  exact Classical.choose_spec (tensorMap_exists q a b) U x y
+
+
+private theorem tensor_hom_ext
+    {H : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{r}}
+    {f g : (toSheaf (ring R)).obj (M ⊗ N) ⟶ H}
+    (h : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) (y : N.val.obj U),
+      f.hom.app U (tensorSection R M N U x y) =
+        g.hom.app U (tensorSection R M N U x y)) : f = g := by
+  apply (cancel_epi ((toSheaf (ring R)).map (tensorObjIsoSheafification M N).inv)).mp
+  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
+  apply sheafify_hom_ext _ _ _ H.property
+  ext U z
+  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
+  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
+  | tmul x y =>
+      unfold tensorSection at h
+      exact h U x y
+  | add z w hz hw => simpa only [_root_.map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hw
+
+private theorem tensorMap_precomp
+    {L K : SheafOfModules.{r} (ring R)} (f : L ⟶ M) (g : K ⟶ N) :
+    (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ tensorMap q a b = tensorMap q (f ≫ a) (g ≫ b) := by
+  apply (toSheaf (ring R)).map_injective
+  apply tensor_hom_ext
+  intro U x y
+  change (tensorMap q a b).val.app U ((f ⊗ₘ g).val.app U
+      (tensorSection R L K U x y)) =
+    (tensorMap q (f ≫ a) (g ≫ b)).val.app U (tensorSection R L K U x y)
+  rw [tensorHom_section R, tensorMap_section, tensorMap_section]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem tensorMap_postcomp
+    {L K : SheafOfModules.{r} (ring S)} (f : M' ⟶ L) (g : N' ⟶ K) :
+    tensorMap q a b ≫ (res q).map (f ⊗ₘ g) =
+      tensorMap q (a ≫ (res q).map f) (b ≫ (res q).map g) := by
+  apply (toSheaf (ring R)).map_injective
+  apply tensor_hom_ext
+  intro U x y
+  change (f ⊗ₘ g).val.app U ((tensorMap q a b).val.app U
+      (tensorSection R M N U x y)) =
+    (tensorMap q (a ≫ (res q).map f) (b ≫ (res q).map g)).val.app U
+      (tensorSection R M N U x y)
+  rw [tensorMap_section, tensorHom_section S, tensorMap_section]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem tensorMap_naturality
+    {L K : SheafOfModules.{r} (ring R)} {L' K' : SheafOfModules.{r} (ring S)}
+    (c : L ⟶ (res q).obj L') (d : K ⟶ (res q).obj K')
+    (f : M ⟶ L) (g : N ⟶ K) (f' : M' ⟶ L') (g' : N' ⟶ K')
+    (ha : f ≫ c = a ≫ (res q).map f') (hb : g ≫ d = b ≫ (res q).map g') :
+    (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ tensorMap q c d = tensorMap q a b ≫ (res q).map (f' ⊗ₘ g') := by
+  rw [tensorMap_precomp, tensorMap_postcomp, ha, hb]
+
+omit [EssentiallySmall.{r} C] [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})]
+  [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}] in
+private theorem forget_preserves_colimits (A : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
+    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}] :
+    PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (toSheaf.{r} A) := by
+  constructor
+  intro K _
+  exact SheafOfModules.preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf A K
+
+
+
+section Complexes
+
+variable
+  {P Q : CochainComplex
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ}
+  {P' Q' : CochainComplex
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S)) ℤ}
+  (a : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
+    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map q)).mapHomologicalComplex
+      (.up ℤ)).obj P')
+  (b : Q ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
+    ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map q)).mapHomologicalComplex
+      (.up ℤ)).obj Q')
+  [HasCountableCoproducts
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
+  [HasCountableCoproducts
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))]
+
+
+private theorem total_tensor_hom_ext [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
+    (j : ℤ) {H : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{r}}
+    {f g : (toSheaf (ring R)).obj
+      ((IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotal _ P Q).X j) ⟶ H}
+    (h : ∀ (p k : ℤ) (hpk : p + k = j) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
+      (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X k).val.obj U),
+      f.hom.app U ((IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k j hpk).val.app U
+        (tensorSection R (P.X p) (Q.X k) U x y)) =
+      g.hom.app U ((IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k j hpk).val.app U
+        (tensorSection R (P.X p) (Q.X k) U x y))) : f = g := by
+  have := forget_preserves_colimits (ring R)
+  let D : { z : ℤ × ℤ // z.1 + z.2 = j } → SheafOfModules.{r} (ring R) :=
+    fun x ↦ P.X x.val.1 ⊗ Q.X x.val.2
+  have hc := isColimitOfPreserves (toSheaf (ring R)) (coproductIsCoproduct D)
+  apply hc.hom_ext
+  rintro ⟨⟨⟨p, k⟩, hpk⟩⟩
+  change (toSheaf (ring R)).map
+      (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k j hpk) ≫ f =
+    (toSheaf (ring R)).map
+      (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k j hpk) ≫ g
+  apply tensor_hom_ext
+  intro U x y
+  exact h p k hpk U x y
+
+private noncomputable def tensorComplexMapX (j : ℤ) :
+    (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotal _ P Q).X j ⟶
+      (res q).obj ((IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotal _ P' Q').X j) :=
+  IntegralTotalProof.mapX (P := P) (Q := Q) (P' := P') (Q' := Q')
+    (res q) (fun p k ↦ tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k)) j
+
+private theorem ι_tensorComplexMapX (p k j : ℤ) (h : p + k = j) :
+    IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k j h ≫
+        tensorComplexMapX q a b j =
+      tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k) ≫ (res q).map
+        (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P' Q' p k j h) := by
+  exact IntegralTotalProof.ι_mapX (P := P) (Q := Q) (P' := P') (Q' := Q')
+    (res q) (fun p k ↦ tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k)) p k j h
+
+attribute [local irreducible] tensorComplexMapX
+
+omit [HasCountableCoproducts
+  (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
+  [HasCountableCoproducts
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))] in
+private theorem tensorMap_d_left (p p' k : ℤ) :
+    (P.d p p' ▷ Q.X k) ≫ tensorMap q (a.f p') (b.f k) =
+      tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k) ≫ (res q).map (P'.d p p' ▷ Q'.X k) := by
+  rw [← tensorHom_id, ← tensorHom_id, tensorMap_precomp, tensorMap_postcomp]
+  simp only [Category.id_comp, (res q).map_id, Category.comp_id]
+  have ha := (a.comm p p').symm
+  change P.d p p' ≫ a.f p' = a.f p ≫ (res q).map (P'.d p p') at ha
+  rw [ha]
+
+omit [HasCountableCoproducts
+  (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
+  [HasCountableCoproducts
+    (SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))] in
+private theorem tensorMap_d_right (p k k' : ℤ) :
+    (P.X p ◁ Q.d k k') ≫ tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k') =
+      tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k) ≫ (res q).map (P'.X p ◁ Q'.d k k') := by
+  rw [← id_tensorHom, ← id_tensorHom, tensorMap_precomp, tensorMap_postcomp]
+  simp only [Category.id_comp, (res q).map_id, Category.comp_id]
+  have hb := (b.comm k k').symm
+  change Q.d k k' ≫ b.f k' = b.f k ≫ (res q).map (Q'.d k k') at hb
+  rw [hb]
+
+private noncomputable def tensorComplexMap :
+    (Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring R))).map₂CochainComplex).obj
+        (P, Q) ⟶
+      ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
+        ((Functor.uncurry.obj
+          (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring S))).map₂CochainComplex).obj (P', Q')) :=
+  IntegralTotalProof.mapComplex (res q) (fun p k ↦ tensorMap q (a.f p) (b.f k))
+    (fun p p' k ↦ tensorMap_d_left q a b p p' k)
+    (fun p k k' ↦ tensorMap_d_right q a b p k k')
+
+private theorem tensorComplexMap_f (j : ℤ) :
+    (tensorComplexMap q a b).f j = tensorComplexMapX q a b j := by
+  unfold tensorComplexMap tensorComplexMapX
+  exact IntegralTotalProof.mapComplex_f _ _ _ _ j
+
+attribute [local irreducible] tensorComplexMap
+
+
+private theorem tensorComplexMap_generator
+    (p k : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X k).val.obj U) :
+    ((tensorComplexMap q a b).f (p + k)).val.app U
+      ((IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P Q p k (p + k) rfl).val.app U
+        (tensorSection R (P.X p) (Q.X k) U x y)) =
+      (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P' Q' p k (p + k) rfl).val.app U
+        (tensorSection S (P'.X p) (Q'.X k) U
+          ((a.f p).val.app U x) ((b.f k).val.app U y)) := by
+  simp only [tensorComplexMap_f]
+  have h := ι_tensorComplexMapX q a b p k (p + k) rfl
+  have he := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.val.app U (tensorSection R _ _ U x y)) h
+  exact he.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦
+    (IntegralTotalProof.tensorTotalι _ P' Q' p k (p + k) rfl).val.app U z)
+      (tensorMap_section q (a.f p) (b.f k) U x y))
+
+private theorem tensorComplexMap_naturality [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
+    {L K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} (ring R)) ℤ}
+    {L' K' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} (ring S)) ℤ}
+    (c : L ⟶ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L')
+    (d : K ⟶ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K')
+    (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (f' : P' ⟶ L') (g' : Q' ⟶ K')
+    (ha : f ≫ c = a ≫ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f')
+    (hb : g ≫ d = b ≫ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g') :
+    (Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring R))).map₂CochainComplex).map
+        (f, g) ≫ tensorComplexMap q c d =
+      tensorComplexMap q a b ≫ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
+        ((Functor.uncurry.obj
+          (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring S))).map₂CochainComplex).map (f', g')) := by
+  unfold tensorComplexMap
+  apply IntegralTotalProof.mapComplex_naturality
+  intro p k
+  apply tensorMap_naturality q (a.f p) (b.f k) (c.f p) (d.f k)
+    (f.f p) (g.f k) (f'.f p) (g'.f k)
+  · exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z.f p) ha
+  · exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z.f k) hb
+
+private theorem tensorComplexMap_naturality_apply [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
+    {L K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} (ring R)) ℤ}
+    {L' K' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} (ring S)) ℤ}
+    (c : L ⟶ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L')
+    (d : K ⟶ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K')
+    (f : P ⟶ L) (g : Q ⟶ K) (f' : P' ⟶ L') (g' : Q' ⟶ K')
+    (ha : f ≫ c = a ≫ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f')
+    (hb : g ≫ d = b ≫ ((res q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g')
+    (j : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
+    (x : (((Functor.uncurry.obj
+      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring R))).map₂CochainComplex).obj (P, Q)).X j).val.obj U) :
+    ((tensorComplexMap q c d).f j).val.app U
+        ((((Functor.uncurry.obj
+          (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring R))).map₂CochainComplex).map (f, g)).f j).val.app
+            U x) =
+      ((((Functor.uncurry.obj
+        (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules (ring S))).map₂CochainComplex).map (f', g')).f j).val.app
+          U (((tensorComplexMap q a b).f j).val.app U x)) := by
+  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ (z.f j).val.app U x)
+    (tensorComplexMap_naturality q a b c d f g f' g' ha hb)
+
+end Complexes
+
+end SheafOfModules.IntegralTensorProof

+namespace SheafOfModules.IntegralScalarProof
+variable {C : Type c} [Category.{d} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+  {S T : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}} (q : S ⟶ T)
+  (M : SheafOfModules.{r} S) (N : SheafOfModules.{r} T)
+
+private noncomputable def retypeMap
+    (φ : (toSheaf S).obj M ⟶ (toSheaf T).obj N)
+    (hφ : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj U) (x : M.val.obj U),
+      φ.hom.app U (s • x) = q.hom.app U s •
+        (show N.val.obj U from φ.hom.app U x)) :
+    M ⟶ (restrictScalars q).obj N where
+  val :=
+    { app := fun U ↦ ModuleCat.ofHom
+        (X := M.val.obj U) (Y := ((restrictScalars q).obj N).val.obj U)
+        { toFun := φ.hom.app U
+          map_add' := _root_.map_add _
+          map_smul' := hφ U }
+      naturality := by
+        intro U V a
+        ext x
+        exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (φ.hom.naturality a) x }
+
+section Composition
+
+variable {C : Type c} [Category.{d} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+  {R S T : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}} (f : R ⟶ S) (g : R ⟶ T) (q : S ⟶ T)
+  (hq : f ≫ q = g) (M : SheafOfModules.{r} S) (N : SheafOfModules.{r} T)
+include hq in
+private theorem coefficient_comp (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : R.obj.obj U) :
+    q.hom.app U (f.hom.app U s) = g.hom.app U s :=
+  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom.app U) hq) s
+private noncomputable def restrictMap (φ : M ⟶ (restrictScalars q).obj N) :
+    (restrictScalars f).obj M ⟶ (restrictScalars g).obj N where
+  val :=
+    { app := fun U ↦ ModuleCat.ofHom
+        (X := ((restrictScalars f).obj M).val.obj U)
+        (Y := ((restrictScalars g).obj N).val.obj U)
+        { toFun := φ.val.app U
+          map_add' := _root_.map_add _
+          map_smul' := fun s x ↦ by
+            change φ.val.app U (f.hom.app U s • (show M.val.obj U from x)) =
+              g.hom.app U s • (show N.val.obj U from φ.val.app U x)
+            have h := (φ.val.app U).hom.map_smul (f.hom.app U s) (show M.val.obj U from x)
+            change φ.val.app U (f.hom.app U s • (show M.val.obj U from x)) =
+              q.hom.app U (f.hom.app U s) • (show N.val.obj U from φ.val.app U x) at h
+            rw [coefficient_comp f g q hq] at h
+            exact h }
+      naturality := by
+        intro U V a
+        ext x
+        exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply φ.val a x }
+private noncomputable def liftMap [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f.hom]
+    (φ : (restrictScalars f).obj M ⟶ (restrictScalars g).obj N) :
+    M ⟶ (restrictScalars q).obj N := by
+  let φ' : (restrictScalars f).obj M ⟶
+      (restrictScalars f).obj ((restrictScalars q).obj N) :=
+    { val :=
+        { app := fun U ↦ ModuleCat.ofHom
+            (X := ((restrictScalars f).obj M).val.obj U)
+            (Y := ((restrictScalars f).obj ((restrictScalars q).obj N)).val.obj U)
+            { toFun := φ.val.app U
+              map_add' := _root_.map_add _
+              map_smul' := fun s x ↦ by
+                have h := (φ.val.app U).hom.map_smul s x
+                change φ.val.app U (f.hom.app U s • (show M.val.obj U from x)) =
+                  q.hom.app U (f.hom.app U s) •
+                    (show N.val.obj U from φ.val.app U x)
+                rw [coefficient_comp f g q hq]
+                exact h }
+          naturality := by
+            intro U V a
+            ext x
+            exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply φ.val a x } }
+  exact ⟨(PresheafOfModules.restrictHomEquivOfIsLocallySurjective f.hom N.isSheaf).symm
+    φ'.val⟩
+private theorem liftMap_apply [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f.hom]
+    (φ : (restrictScalars f).obj M ⟶ (restrictScalars g).obj N)
+    (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) :
+    (liftMap f g q hq M N φ).val.app U x = φ.val.app U x := by
+  rfl
+
+private noncomputable def restrictStep :
+    restrictScalars q ⋙ restrictScalars f ⟶ restrictScalars g where
+  app N := restrictMap f g q hq ((restrictScalars q).obj N) N (𝟙 _)
+  naturality := by
+    intro M N φ
+    ext U x
+    rfl
+
+private noncomputable def restrictComplexMap
+    {P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} S) ℤ}
+    {Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} T) ℤ}
+    (φ : P ⟶ ((restrictScalars q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) :
+    ((restrictScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ⟶
+      ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q :=
+  ((restrictScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map φ ≫
+    ((restrictStep f g q hq).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app Q
+
+private theorem restrictComplexMap_apply
+    {P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} S) ℤ}
+    {Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} T) ℤ}
+    (φ : P ⟶ ((restrictScalars q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
+    (j : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X j).val.obj U) :
+    ((restrictComplexMap f g q hq φ).f j).val.app U x = (φ.f j).val.app U x := by
+  rfl
+
+end Composition
+
+end SheafOfModules.IntegralScalarProof

+namespace SheafOfModules.IntegralPullbackProof
+variable {C : Type c} [Category.{d} C] {D : Type c'} [Category.{d'} D]
+  {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
+  (F : C ⥤ D) [F.IsContinuous J K]
+  {R₀ R₁ : Sheaf K RingCat.{r}} {S₀ S₁ : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}}
+  (qR : R₀ ⟶ R₁) (qS : S₀ ⟶ S₁)
+  (φ₀ : S₀ ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{r} J K).obj R₀)
+  (φ₁ : S₁ ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{r} J K).obj R₁)
+  (h : qS ≫ φ₁ = φ₀ ≫ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{r} J K).map qR)
+private noncomputable def pushRestrictionIso :
+    restrictScalars.{r} qR ⋙ pushforward φ₀ ≅
+      pushforward φ₁ ⋙ restrictScalars qS :=
+  pushforwardComp (G := 𝟭 D) φ₀ qR ≪≫ pushforwardCongr h.symm ≪≫

+/-

+module
+
+public import Sheaf.Paper.IntegralReductionTowerUnrestricted
+import all Sheaf.Paper.IntegralReductionTowerUnrestricted
+
+/-! # Semilinearity of the canonical finite reduction transitions
+
+The explicit change-of-rings map retains its finite scalar action after restriction
+to completed coefficients. Source: Stacks Tag 03EK
+(blueprint: lem-pur-integral-reduction-transition-semilinear).
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+
+universe t u a b r
+
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
+open scoped ChangeOfRings
+
+namespace SheafOfModules.UnrestrictedTowerProof
+
+variable {C : Type a} [Category.{b} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})]
+  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{r}] [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
+  {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r}}
+  (f : R ⟶ S) (g : R ⟶ T) (q : S ⟶ T) (hq : f ≫ q = g)
+  (M : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
+  (F : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R) ⥤
+    SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))
+  (G : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R) ⥤
+    SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj T))
+  (hf : ∀ N, F.obj N = changeOfRings f N)
+  (hg : ∀ N, G.obj N = changeOfRings g N)
+
+private theorem identifiedMap_smul (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj U)
+    (x : (F.obj M).val.obj U) :
+    (identifiedMap f g q hq M F G hf hg).val.app U (s • x) =
+      q.hom.app U s • (show (G.obj M).val.obj U from
+        (identifiedMap f g q hq M F G hf hg).val.app U x) := by
+  let a := (eqToHom (hf M)).val.app U
+  let b := (sheafMap f g q hq M).val.app U
+  let c := (eqToHom (hg M).symm).val.app U
+  have hb : b (s • a x) = q.hom.app U s •
+      (show (changeOfRings g M).val.obj U from b (a x)) := b.hom.map_smul s (a x)
+  unfold identifiedMap restrictedMap
+  change c (b (a (s • x))) = q.hom.app U s • c (b (a x))
+  rw [map_smul, hb, map_smul]
+
+end SheafOfModules.UnrestrictedTowerProof
+
+namespace WeilConjectures
+
+variable (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
+  [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
+
+attribute [local irreducible] SheafOfModules.UnrestrictedTowerProof.sheafMap
+  completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted
+  completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted
+
+/-- Finite reduction transitions are semilinear for the finite coefficient reduction.
+Source: Stacks Tag 03EK (blueprint: lem-pur-integral-reduction-transition-semilinear).
+Proof: identify the selected natural transformation with the termwise construction
+by its unique pure-tensor characterization. The construction is restriction of an
+actually linear map from the higher finite coefficient ring to the lower one. -/
+theorem unrestrictedIntegralTransition_smul (n : ℕ)
+    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ)
+    (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y (n + 1)).obj.obj U)
+    (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y (n + 1)).obj P).X i).val.obj U) :
+    (((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n).app P).f i).val.app U (s • x) =
+      (integralCoefficientSheafTransition l E Y n).hom.app U s •
+        (show (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X i).val.obj U from
+          (((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n).app P).f i).val.app U x) := by
+  let τ : unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E Y (n + 1) ⟶
+      unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E Y n :=
+    { app := fun Q ↦
+        { f := fun j ↦ unrestrictedModuleStep l E Y n (Q.X j)
+          comm' := fun j k _ ↦
+            (unrestrictedModuleStep_naturality l E Y n (Q.d j k)).symm }
+      naturality := fun Q Q' a ↦ by
+        apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
+        intro j
+        exact unrestrictedModuleStep_naturality l E Y n (a.f j) }
+  have hτ : τ = unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n :=
+    (unrestrictedIntegralTransition_existsUnique l E Y n).unique
+      (fun Q j V a z ↦ unrestrictedModuleStep_tmul l E Y n (Q.X j) V a z)
+      (unrestrictedIntegralTransition_existsUnique l E Y n).exists.choose_spec
+  rw [← hτ]
+  dsimp only [τ]
+  unfold unrestrictedModuleStep
+  exact SheafOfModules.UnrestrictedTowerProof.identifiedMap_smul
+    (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E Y (n + 1))
+    (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E Y n)
+    (unrestrictedCoefficientStep l E Y n) (unrestrictedCoefficientStep_comp l E Y n) (P.X i)
+    (unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l E Y (n + 1))
+    (unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l E Y n)
+    (unrestrictedReduction_obj l E Y (n + 1)) (unrestrictedReduction_obj l E Y n) U s x
+
+end WeilConjectures
